stem.text: A person stands at the side of a straight railway track. A train moves towards the person and emits sound from its whistle. The person hears a sound of frequency $1690\,\text{Hz}$ as the train approaches him.
The person then hears sound of frequency $1500\,\text{Hz}$ as the train moves away from him. The speed of sound in air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the speed of the train?
